canonical_project: NEXTDC KL1 Kuala Lumpur Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC announced KL1 Kuala Lumpur opened for business on May 14, 2026. Its official facility page describes KL1 as located in Petaling Jaya and delivering 65 MW of IT capacity. Note: Petaling Jaya is in Selangor/Greater Kuala Lumpur rather than physically inside the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur.
